title: BioMate Learning Series
coverageNote: 28 bilingual source chapters plus focused episodes. This is the initial editorial inventory, not proof of exhaustive product coverage. Verify shipped workflows and add unmapped functions before declaring coverage complete.
releaseRequirements: Demonstrated function verified in real BioMate with reproducible evidence
Scientific claims reviewed against actual inputs and outputs
English and Chinese editorial and terminology review
Readable screenshots and diagrams at delivery resolution
Narration, captions and timing reviewed in the final encoded video
